name: Figma
description: Figma is a browser- and desktop-based design tool where teams create interface designs, prototypes, and increasingly code together in a shared, real-time canvas.
best_for: Positioned for multidisciplinary product teams — designers, engineers, PMs — at organizations ranging from startups to large enterprises.

alternatives.name: Canva
alternatives.description: An online visual design platform letting non-designers create graphics, presentations, and print materials from templates.
alternatives.best_for: Non-designers making marketing and social content quickly

alternatives.name: Sketch
alternatives.description: A vector-based UI/UX design application for creating interface designs and interactive prototypes, macOS only.
